title: Logarithmically Coupled p-Laplacian Systems: From Discrete Ground States to Rigidity and Critical Continuous Limits
summary: This paper introduces a new coupled p-Laplacian system with logarithmic nonlinearities, on locally finite graphs for p>4 and, in the critical case p=N>4, on R^N via a regularised formulation. The logarithmic coupling renders the energy functional ill-defined on the natural Sobolev space. To address this non-separable singularity, we develop an exponent calibration technique that converts the logarithmic terms into strictly lower-order power estimates.
